_note: Rule packs sold through Whop (convex/packs.ts). Same shape as a condition in data/rules/conditions.json: every quote is copied from its source page and re-checked by `npm run verify:sources`. Status is "sourced": no clinician has reviewed these. Tags come from data/tags.json only.

pregnancy.label: Pregnancy
pregnancy.blurb: What to leave out and what to keep low while you are pregnant.

rules.reason: Alcohol is on the list of things to avoid during pregnancy because it can harm the baby.
rules.quote: Do not drink alcohol, such as wine, beer, or hard liquor.

rules.reason: Raw and undercooked meat, eggs and seafood can carry germs that cause illness in you or your baby.
rules.quote: Avoid soft cheeses made from unpasteurized or raw milk; raw cookie dough; undercooked meats, eggs, and seafood; and deli salads.

rules.reason: Cheese and milk that are not pasteurized can carry germs that cause illness in you or your baby.
rules.quote: Avoid soft cheeses made from unpasteurized or raw milk; raw cookie dough; undercooked meats, eggs, and seafood; and deli salads.

rules.reason: During pregnancy the advice is to keep caffeine under 200 mg a day, about 12 ounces of coffee.
rules.quote: limit drinks with caffeine to less than 200 mg per day

ibs_low_fodmap.label: IBS, low FODMAP
ibs_low_fodmap.blurb: The foods a low FODMAP diet cuts back on, flagged on every scan.

source.title: Eating, Diet, & Nutrition for Irritable Bowel Syndrome (NIDDK)

rules.reason: Onion and garlic contain FODMAPs, carbohydrates that are hard to digest and are reduced on a low FODMAP diet.
rules.quote: vegetables such as artichokes, asparagus, beans, cabbage, cauliflower, garlic and garlic salts, lentils, mushrooms, onions, and sugar snap or snow peas

rules.reason: Milk and milk products contain FODMAPs and are reduced on a low FODMAP diet.
rules.quote: dairy products such as milk, milk products, soft cheeses, yogurt, custard, and ice cream

rules.reason: Some people with IBS have more symptoms after eating gluten, so cutting back on it is one of the changes that may be suggested.
rules.quote: Your doctor may recommend avoiding foods that contain gluten

rules.reason: Honey contains FODMAPs and is reduced on a low FODMAP diet.
rules.quote: honey and foods with high-fructose corn syrup

hemodialysis.label: Hemodialysis
hemodialysis.blurb: Potassium, phosphorus and salt between dialysis sessions.

rules.reason: Potassium can build up between dialysis sessions and affect your heartbeat, so potassium-rich foods are kept to small portions.
rules.quote: To control potassium levels, limit potassium-rich foods such as avocados, bananas, kiwis, and dried fruit.

rules.reason: Potassium can build up between dialysis sessions and affect your heartbeat.
rules.quote: Eating too much potassium can be dangerous to your heart and may even cause death.

rules.reason: Too much phosphorus in your blood pulls calcium from your bones, and processed and packaged foods are high in it.
rules.quote: Processed and packaged foods contain especially high levels of phosphorus.

rules.reason: Salt makes you thirsty, and extra liquid builds up between dialysis sessions.
rules.quote: Avoid salty foods such as chips and pretzels.

rules.reason: Salt substitutes are made with potassium, which builds up between dialysis sessions.
rules.quote: Do not use salt substitutes because they contain potassium.
